LESSON: WRITING 1.5.1 HANDWRITING: LEGIBILITY AND NEATNESS

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.5: Writing 1.5.1 Handwriting: Legibility and Neatness

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Writing 1.5.1 Handwriting: Legibility and Neatness. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why should we write legibly and clearly?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. describe features of legible and neat handwriting for efficient writing
2. write texts legibly and neatly for effective communication

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: WRITING 1.5.1 HANDWRITING: LEGIBILITY AND NEATNESS
Subject: ENGLISH · Grade: Grade 7
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Writing 1.5.1 Handwriting: Legibility and Neatness helps you succeed in ENGLISH. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at school, at home, and in your community in Kenya.

KEY FACTS: WRITING 1.5.1 HANDWRITING: LEGIBILITY AND NEATNESS
Language skills grow by daily practice: listen carefully, speak clearly, read every day, write neatly.
Model → guided practice → independent practice.
Always use complete sentences when writing answers.

PART 1: Describe features of legible and neat handwriting for efficient writing

What this means
In this part you learn to describe features of legible and neat handwriting for efficient writing. You will use ideas from at school, at home, and in your community in Kenya.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: describe features of legible and neat handwriting for efficient writing.
2. Listen, speak, read, then write using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Model reading: Read a short paragraph about “Writing 1.5.1 Handwriting: Legibility and Neatness”, then retell it in 3 sentences.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can describe features of legible and neat handwriting for efficient writing. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Write texts legibly and neatly for effective communication

What this means
In this part you learn to write texts legibly and neatly for effective communication. You will use ideas from at school, at home, and in your community in Kenya.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: write texts legibly and neatly for effective communication.
2. Listen, speak, read, then write using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Model speaking: Say 4 clear sentences about Writing 1.5.1 Handwriting: Legibility and Neatness to a partner.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can write texts legibly and neatly for effective communication. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Writing 1.5.1 Handwriting: Legibility and Neatness is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Read a short paragraph about “Writing 1.5.1 Handwriting: Legibility and Neatness”, then retell it in 3 sentences. (skill: describe features of legible and neat handwriting for efficient writing)

Example 2: Say 4 clear sentences about Writing 1.5.1 Handwriting: Legibility and Neatness to a partner. (skill: write texts legibly and neatly for effective communication)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Writing 1.5.1 Handwriting: Legibility and Neatness to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: describe features of legible and neat handwriting for efficient writing.
3. Practise this skill: write texts legibly and neatly for effective communication.
4. Make one local Kenya example of Writing 1.5.1 Handwriting: Legibility and Neatness from your county, market, farm, or school.
5. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Writing 1.5.1 Handwriting: Legibility and Neatness: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 7 learner study Writing 1.5.1 Handwriting: Legibility and Neatness?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why should we write legibly and clearly?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Writing 1.5.1 Handwriting: Legibility and Neatness means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: describe features of legible and neat handwriting for efficient writing.
5. Be able to: write texts legibly and neatly for effective communication.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
